name: Goshi Norito
source:
Norito is a Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He has a rebellious personality, but is otherwise good-natured. He tends to be rather laid-back and likes to joke around. He excels more in illusions rather than physical attacks, and covers Guren who mainly fights in close combat.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Norito_Goshi]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
